scientific_integrity: A self-contained analytical proof is supplied with a finite-dimensional independent numerical reproducer. No independent audit or external verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive equal disk areas, large separation, top two spectral eigenvalues only; possible unindexed historical equivalent. The proof uses exact restriction factorization, coherent-state inner product, a Hilbert–Schmidt norm estimate and Schur-complement min–max. Numerical checks are corroborative only.
title: Sharp coherent-state splitting for two distant Gaussian localization disks
